key_idea: If the rolled prefix already repeats a value Ashley cannot win; otherwise the remaining rolls must be a falling factorial (6-n)(6-n-1)... of unused values.
sketch: Read the n rolls; total completions are 6^(4-n). If the prefix has a duplicate, Ashley has 0 ways. Otherwise Ashley has prod_{i=n}^{3} (6-i) ways and Brandon gets the rest. O(1); could also just brute-force all at most 216 completions.
